question: Should Control UI ship persistent thumbnail previews and Open, Download, and Copy controls for managed generated images once the cache-lifetime defect and exact-head proof gap are resolved?
rationale: The patch adds a new default Control UI interaction surface rather than repairing an established behavior contract, so maintainers should explicitly sponsor or defer the product direction.

options.title: Sponsor the image actions
options.body: Accept the feature direction after the Blob lifetime repair and exact-head browser proof demonstrate the requested flows.

options.title: Defer the interaction surface
options.body: Keep the existing managed-image rendering path and close or narrow the proposal until a maintainer prioritizes these controls.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the image actions
recommendation.body: Accept the feature direction after the Blob lifetime repair and exact-head browser proof demonstrate the requested flows.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently landed the current-main managed-image rendering and transcript-identity implementation that this feature extends.
